identity.name: Cocineros
identity.notes: The official site, exact-address live Toast ordering page, current official menu PDF, and accepting-orders catering page all identify the same operating Hyattsville restaurant. The official phone is 240-828-5976. San Alejo and Comedor y Pupuseria San Alejo are sibling businesses/locations and are not merged.

sources.excerpt: The current official site identifies Cocineros in Hyattsville at 3513 East-West Hwy, publishes hours and phone 240-828-5976, and directly links the current main menu PDF, happy-hour PDF, Toast ordering, and catering menu.

The one-page PDF currently linked as Menu was freshly rendered and visually checked. It identifies Cocineros at the exact Hyattsville address and lists 32 current food presentations after option variants are consolidated.

The two-page PDF currently linked as Happy Hour was freshly rendered and visually checked. Its Chicken Nachos and three-taco food offers map to current products; margaritas, mojitos, and beer are alcohol-only and excluded.

The official site's Online Order link opens the live Toast menu for Cocineros at 3513 East West Hwy, Hyattsville. Fresh browser inspection found 65 distinct food products and 20 nonalcoholic drinks after repeated Featured and cross-category presentations were consolidated.

The official accepting-orders catering page confirms the exact Hyattsville pickup address and exposes 16 Food Trays products with current descriptions, dietary badges, item-level allergy disclosures, and explicit shared-fryer gluten statements on five products.

The frozen baseline cited this former Wix restaurant-menu API. A fresh unauthenticated request no longer returned its historical item payload; current catering scope is taken from the live official catering page instead.
This frozen-source Toast route is for Comedor y Pupuseria San Alejo, a separate sibling business/menu, not Cocineros at 3513 East-West Hwy.
This frozen-source Toast route is for San Alejo Restaurant at 7643 New Hampshire Ave, a separate sibling location, not the target Cocineros restaurant.

Fresh exact-location and official-domain searches for allergen, allergy, ingredients, nutrition, dietary guidance, PDFs, and menus surfaced the current official menus but no comprehensive product-by-allergen matrix.

findings.summary: The official website, current PDFs, live Toast ordering, and accepting-orders catering page bind to Cocineros at 3513 East-West Hwy in Hyattsville. San Alejo and Comedor menus in the frozen union are separate sibling restaurant/location surfaces.

The exact current in-scope union is 101 products: 65 live Toast foods, 20 live nonalcoholic drinks, and 16 current catering products. Main-menu and happy-hour PDF food presentations are entirely represented in that union.

The 123-row frozen catalog combines Cocineros with Toast menus for San Alejo Restaurant and Comedor y Pupuseria San Alejo. Foreign-only items are location mismatches unless a current Cocineros equivalent is independently confirmed.

The baseline includes homepage/AI telemetry, modifier labels, PDF description fragments, stale historical Wix products, and duplicated/order-size presentations. These are removed, marked stale, or reconciled to current canonical products.

The current catering page explicitly says five chips/tostones/flautas tray products use oil shared with foods containing gluten. Those statements remain product-specific may-contain evidence and are not expanded to the whole restaurant.

Several catering items carry Gluten Free badges while configurable flour-tortilla choices or explicit shared-fryer cautions are also disclosed. Direct gluten positives and product-specific cross-contact take precedence; no blanket allergen-free claim is created.

No comprehensive official product-by-allergen matrix was found after all four required searches. Direct positives and explicit item-level cross-contact are retained; unsupported negatives are not inferred.

proposedChanges: Replace the contaminated frozen union with the 101-product exact-location current Cocineros union and exclude sibling San Alejo/Comedor-only rows.
Collapse Featured/category repeats and order-size or PDF-heading presentations into canonical current products; remove modifier, telemetry, AI-label, and description-fragment artifacts.
Replace stale historical Wix items with the 16 products currently exposed by the accepting-orders official catering page.
Publish direct positive allergens only where supported by current official or linked product language; retain the five explicit catering shared-fryer gluten cautions only on their named products.

proposedChanges.notes: The catering page attributes these cautions to shared fryer oil. Do not generalize them to other products or the facility.
